paite: Thugenpa, David tapa, Jerusalem kumpipa thute.
heading: Hinna Phattuamna Bei Ahi

paite: Bangmah loute bangmah lou, bangmah loute bangmah lou, bang teng bangmah lou ahi, Thugenpa'n achi hi.
Asepgimna tengteng ni nuai a asepgim a kipan mihing in bang phattuamna anei a?
Khang khat apai a, khang dang ahong tung a; tangtawn in lei a-om gige.
Ni leng asuak zel a, ni atum zel; huchi in asuahna mun lam ah akik nawn pah hi.
Simlam ah huih apai a, mallam ah akilehhei a; alampi ah akivialhei gige, huan huih alam zuih ah akik nawn zel hi.
Luite tengteng tuipi ah aluanglut ua, himahleh tuipi a dim tuan kei; luite paina mun lam ah, huai lam ah apai nawn uh.
Thil tengteng gimna in adim a; mihing in agen thei kei; muh in mit alungkim kei a, zak in bil leng alungkim sam kei.
A-om khinsa ahong om ding ahi a; hih khitsa hih a om ding ahi a; huchi in ni nuai ah thil thak a-om kei hi.
En dih, "Hiai athak ahi?" chi a mite'n agen uh thil a-om hia? I ma ua hunte ua a-om khinsa ahi.
Khang masate theihgigena a-om kei a; anung a hong om dingte lak ah hong om ding khang nanung lam theihgigena leng a-om sam kei ding.
Kei Thugenpa, Jerusalem ah Israel tung a kumpipa ka hi.
heading: Mipil Tuahsate A Kipan A Thil Theih

paite: Van nuai a hih a omte tengteng tungtang pilna a zong ding leh zongkhe ding a ka lungtang suah ka hi; huai a kisuk ding a mite tapate kiang a Pathian in apiak nakpitak a gimna ahi.
Ni nuai a hih a om nasepte tengteng ka muta a; ngai in, bang teng bangmah lou ahi a, huih nungdelh ahi.
Akawisa bawl tang theih ahi kei; huan akim lou sim theih ahi kei.
Keimah lungtang ka houlimpih a, "Ngai in, Jerusalem a ka ma a omte tengteng sang in pilna thupi ka hon muhsak a; ahi, ka lungtang in pilna aneita," chi in.
Huchi in pilna thei ding leh haina haitatna thei ding in ka lungtang ka suk a; hiai leng huih nungdelh ahi chih ka thei hi.
Pil mahmahna ah lungkham mahmahna a-om a; kuapeuh theihna khangsak in lungkhamna akhangsak hi.
